grading: hidden vitest pass-rate over the 5 bug groups; regressions on tests_visible subtract.

bugs.desc: getEventHash serializes the whole event object via JSON.stringify instead of the canonical [0,pubkey,created_at,kind,tags,content] array; includes id/sig and wrong key order.
bugs.fix: serialize the 6-element array with compact JSON, then sha256.

bugs.desc: #e/#p filter matches against values of ALL tags rather than only tags whose name equals the letter.
bugs.fix: filter tags by t[0] === key.slice(1) before comparing t[1].

bugs.desc: since/until comparisons are inverted (since rejects newer events, until rejects older).
bugs.fix: reject when created_at < since, or created_at > until.

bugs.desc: verifyEvent checks the signature against the claimed id but never recomputes the hash, so tampered content passes.
bugs.fix: recompute id via getEventHash and require it equals e.id before/along with schnorr.verify.
